name: Nikhil Adhesives Limited
about: Nikhil Adhesives Limited manufactures and sells polymer emulsions and adhesives in India. It offers rubber, lamination, contact, tile, packaging, sticker, putty, tape, wood, and other adhesives; sealants; and polymer waterproofing and bonding agents, water repellents, integral waterproofing compounds, repairs and restorations, grouts and anchors, surface treatments, admixtures/plasticizers, floor coatings and hardeners, tile grouts and adhesives, waterproofing coating and membrane, crack filling compounds, and anti-corrosive coating solutions. The company also provides adhesive for manufacturing tapes, special applications, and packaging industries; construction chemicals; paint emulsions comprising pure acrylic, styrene acrylic and Vam acrylic co-polymer, Vam-Veova co-polymer, TER-polymer, and polymer additives and powder; polyvinyl acetate co-polymers and homo polymer for textile finishing; and pigment printing and flocking binders, gold printing binders range, carpet binders range, coating agents, fixers and crosslinking agents, functional and speciality additives, thickeners, and dispersants and wetting agents, as well as monomers, solvents, chemicals, opacifiers, and opaque polymers. It offers its products under the Mahacol, Emdilith, Emditex, Emdicryl, Mahafix, and Emdibind brands. The company exports its products to Nepal, Taiwan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, and Africa. Nikhil Adhesives Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
